visual_style: 2D Korean Webtoon Manhwa (Solo Leveling / Castle style, digital cel-shading, crisp ink outlines, zero 3D CGI)

production_rules.zero_regeneration_rule: Once an asset or character is approved, NEVER regenerate from scratch. Always reuse, composite, or inpaint existing locked artwork.
production_rules.same_scene_continuation_rule: Within the same scene (e.g. Scene 5), camera angle cuts MUST preserve exact vehicle geometry, rain density, headlight beams, and character costume DNA without re-inventing from scratch.
production_rules.lettering_engine_lock: All dialogue balloons MUST be rendered via lettering_engine.py with hardcoded font tokens (21px standard, 25px shout, Nirmala UI / Mangal, 2.8px border, 28px radius).
production_rules.reading_layout_format: Infinite Vertical Scroll Mode with dynamic 28px dark gutters, full-bleed smartphone readability, and zero artificial baked borders (standard Korean webtoon format).
strict_negative_exclusions: 3d cgi, 3d render, unreal engine, octane render, digital doll face, porcelain skin, airbrushed skin, oily skin highlights, glossy plastic sheen, smooth gradient shading, wax figure
symmetrical composition, mirrored buildings, mirrored alley walls, symmetrical shopfronts, mirrored character poses, twin postures, tunnel vision, cloned architecture
korean text, hangul characters, hanja, japanese text, kanji, hiragana, katakana, chinese text, reversed english letters, mirrored typography, backwards text, floating neon clusters
seoul street, shinjuku alley, tokyo neon, cyberpunk city, east asian architecture, futuristic sci-fi city, western alleyway, clean modern sidewalks
duplicate bald characters, cloned face models, multiple cigarettes, floating cigarettes, cigarette in both hands, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicate currency notes
